title: How Standard Bank Group automates AI risk assessment for generative AI
summary: Standard Bank Group automated the evidence behind its generative AI approval gates. Working with AWS Professional Services, the bank built an assessment in its own AWS account that scores each use case against international AI standards and its own policies using LLM-as-a-judge o
reason: AWS customer case study describing how Standard Bank built an internal genAI risk-assessment workflow. Not a named model release, no research artifact, no financing/M&A/partnership or market event, no policy action, and no open-source tool release; no rule covers it.
